attempts.summary: On node1 (CentOS Stream 10), built a local file:// package repository at /srv/local-repo (httpd + 11 deps predownloaded, repodata generated with createrepo_c), then blocked the only remote repo host (mirrors.centos.org, via /etc/hosts) and proved remote dnf metadata fetches fail. With remotes unreachable, installed httpd purely from the local repo (--disablerepo='*' --enablerepo=local-repo), verified the package and its files were installed. Restored remote connectivity afterward. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled through the outage, confirmed a changed boot_id post-restart, and verified the local repo, its repo config, and the installed httpd package all persisted, with remote reachability also restored.
